name: Análisis Estilométrico
description: Analiza estilo de escritura características para detectar generado por IA text through stylistic fingerprinting.
useCase: Identifying generado por IA text mediante el análisis de estilo de escritura characteristics unique to human authors
mechanism: Extrae estilométrico características including sentence structure patrones, puntuación usage, paragraph organization, rhetorical devices, and marcadores discursivos. Human writing exhibits consistent personal style signatures, while AI text shows characteristic patrones of the generating model — often more formal, structured, and lacking personal quirks.
source: Uchendu et al. (2020) - Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation, EMNLP
algorithm: Stylometric Feature Extraction + Statistical Pattern Classification + Discourse Analysis
parameters: Features: 50+ stylistic markers, Min length: 200 words, Analysis: n-grama distribución, function frecuencia de palabras, legibilidad indices
strengths:
• Captures deep estilo de escritura patrones
• Effective on longer documents
• Can distinguish entre different AI models
• Robust against simple paraphrasing
limitations:
• Requires sufficient text length for reliable análisis
• Multi-author texts are challenging
• Professional editing can mask style signals
• Style varies by genre and context

references.title: Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
Neal, T. et al. (2018). Surveying Stylometry Techniques and Applications. ACM Computing Surveys.
Kumarage, T. et al. (2023). Stylometric Detection of AI-Generated Text in Twitter Timelines. arXiv.
